description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

Cost 3 Tally

One swing, from as high as your arms go, with everything twenty years put into them.

Make a Strike with a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll. On a hit it deals triple weapon damage rather than the usual amount, and on a critical hit the target is knocked prone and stunned 2. Spending Tally this way is not a Redline and causes no Slip. If the Strike misses, the Tally is spent anyway.
